item.title: Confident of Air Supremacy, U.S. Sends B-52 Bombers Over Iran
item.summary: Iran continued to retaliate across the region on Tuesday but markets saw hopes that fighting might ebb. Israel said it would occupy a large chunk of Lebanon even after the war ends.

item.title: Trump Redefines ‘Regime Change’ in Iran War
item.summary: President Trump and his aides have made contradictory statements on whether the United States and Israel have transformed the Iranian government through violence.

item.title: Trump Shares Video of Bombing in Iranian City of Isfahan
item.summary: President Trump shared a video of the attack, which the Pentagon said had targeted an ammunition depot.

item.title: Israel Signals Plans to Occupy Southern Lebanon After Ground Invasion
item.summary: Israeli forces will control “the entire area” from the border to the Litani River, up to 20 miles into Lebanon, the defense minister said. He indicated Israel would control it after the ground invasion ends.

item.title: From Oil to Food, the Iran War Is Squeezing the Global Economy
item.summary: The effects of the war in Iran are squeezing consumers, businesses and governments around the world, raising the prices of many essential goods.

item.title: Arab World Faces ‘Profound’ Economic Crisis From Iran War, U.N. Agency Warns
item.summary: An economic simulation warned that the region’s economy could lose more than $190 billion in just one month, and that Gulf states that have often bankrolled reconstruction efforts will be less able to help.

item.title: Trump Faces a Decision on Whether to Start a Ground War in Iran
item.summary: The president wants a negotiation, but the Iranians say they are refusing until a cease-fire is declared. And while Marines and the 82nd Airborne Division offer new leverage, the risks escalate quickly.

item.title: How the U.K.’s Leader Decides Which U.S. Bombers to Let Fly Against Iran
item.summary: As the United States expands its armada of warplanes on British soil, Prime Minister Keir Starmer says he is trying to defend Britain’s interests while keeping the country out of war.

item.title: Here’s What Happened in the War in the Middle East on Monday
item.summary: Iran maintained that no negotiations have been held with the United States, and said none would while the fighting continues.

item.title: A New U.S. Missile Hit a Sports Hall in Iran. Here’s What We Know About It.
item.summary: Barely out of prototype testing, the Precision Strike Missile is shrouded in secrecy — including which Persian Gulf countries the Army is launching them from.
